summary.text: Regina Liparoto, also known as Reggie, is the Republican candidate for the Georgia House of Representatives, District 141, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Carolyn Hugley (D).
Liparoto ran in the Republican primary for Georgia's 2nd Congressional District in 2024, which A. Wayne Johnson and Chuck Hand advanced from to a runoff.
